name: yupi-hot-monitor
description: AI 热点监控工具 — HotPulse

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.demo: npm run db:push --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server
